body:
Hi team,

I will be honest, the sentence that stopped me on your site was this one: your own copy promises to create a customize cleaning for each and every home, typos and all, with a double period at the end. It sits right in the middle of your sales pitch, and the rest of the page is a long scrolling wall from what looks like a 2019 template.

People booking a cleaning service are inviting strangers into their home, so the website has to feel careful and current. Right now the site works against that feeling, even though the business behind it is clearly established in Gwinnett County.

So I redesigned your homepage, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. The services are laid out cleanly, recurring cleaning and booking sit right up front, and the whole page reads as careful as the business behind it.

I design websites for service companies, and cleaning is a niche I know. Two I built: LA Clean (lacleanco.com), with simple booking front and center, and House Clean Los Angeles (housecleanlosangeles.com), built so visitors can get a price and book in a couple of clicks.

If you like what you see, I can build it into your real site. If not, the PDF is yours either way, no pressure at all.

Best,
Hassan
name: Rite Touch Maids
subject: 🧹 'Customize cleaning' made it onto your homepage
